note: Treg memory / activation status on CCR7 × CD45RA, binary split (CM/EM/EMRA collapsed into a single 'Memory_Treg' bucket). Naive_Treg: resting naive Treg (Miyara Fraction I) — upper-right quadrant (CCR7+, CD45RA+). Memory_Treg: effector / activated Treg (Miyara Fractions II + III aggregated) — broad cluster across the other three quadrants.
tips: Treg memory / activation status (binary split). Naive_Treg: CCR7+ CD45RA+. Memory_Treg: all other CCR7/CD45RA quadrants aggregated. This step collapses CM/EM/EMRA into a single 'memory' bucket, unlike the 4-way split used for conventional CD4/CD8 (Steps 2 & 4). Tissue context: Naive_Treg dominates lymphoid tissues (Spleen, LN); non-lymphoid tissues are memory-biased.
